paper_title: A microwave paraphoton and axion detection experiment with 300 dB electromagnetic shielding at 3 GHz
notes: Microwave light-shining-through-wall (LSW) search for hidden photons (paraphotons) at CERN, March 2012 run. Curve extracted from Fig. 2 (exclusion.pdf in the e-print), a vector figure; the excluded region is the cyan/teal triangle labelled 'Microwave LSW March 2012 CERN'. Axis calibration from tick strokes: x major ticks at -9,-6,-3,0 (Log10 m/eV), y at -9,-6,-3,0 (Log10 chi). Reported curve is the lower/left boundary of the excluded region (chi ABOVE the curve excluded, up to the plot frame at chi=1). Tip (best limit) at m=1.08e-5 eV, chi=7.7e-9, matching the paper's quoted point m=1.1e-5 eV, chi=7.6e-9. Left branch follows chi ~ m^-2 (fitted slope -2.02 in log-log), consistent with Eq.1 Pdet ~ chi^4 (m c^2/(f_sys h))^8. Right edge is a sharp vertical cutoff at the resonance mass m = h*f_sys = 1.22e-5 eV (f_sys=2.9565 GHz). This is a lab LSW limit, not a dark-matter search, so no density dependence (dm_density_assumed null). Paper states no confidence level explicitly (exclusion set from minimum detectable power Pdet=-211 dBm); confidence_level left null. Reported chi directly (never chi^2).
